card.name: February dates and digits before ordinals
card.fires_on: The word February (or Feb.) and the space or digit right after it, where a day number follows. Also digits inside numbers in tables, such as 12 or 125.

modes.label: Digits in number tables
modes.description: A decimal point or digit partway through a number in a table of figures.
